themes.name: 上課用語
themes.intro: 今天是開學第一天！主角在校門口遇到同學，他們在說什麼呢？

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Cima saw ku ngangan nu misu?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Ci Kacaw ku ngangan nu maku.

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Icuwa saw ku luma’ nu misu?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Namaka Angcuh a niyaru’ kaku.

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Namaranam tu haw kisu?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Caay hen!

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: A micakay kaku tu sakaranam, a mihakulung haw kisu?
turns.chineseText: 我要去買早餐，要一起去嗎？

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Awaay ku nikeridan nu maku tu pida, dengay haw kisu a pacaliw i takuwan?
turns.chineseText: 我沒有帶錢。你可以借我錢嗎？

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Hayi pacaliway nu maku kisu.

quests.quest: 你今天第一天上學，趕快認識你旁邊的兩位同學吧！
quests.tips: 問他們：「你叫甚麼名字？」，將名牌放到同學的桌上吧！

lines.indigenousText: cima saw ku ngangan nu misu
lines.displayText: Cima saw ku ngangan nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: Ci Kacaw ku ngangan nu maku.

lines.indigenousText: cima saw ku ngangan nu misu
lines.displayText: Cima saw ku ngangan nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: Ci Panay ku ngangan nu maku.

quests.quest: 很好，現在你認識了同學的名字，
quests.tips: 再問問他們：「你家住哪裡？」吧！

lines.indigenousText: icuwa saw ku luma’ nu misu
lines.displayText: Icuwa saw ku luma’ nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: I Kenuy ku luma’ nu maku.

lines.indigenousText: icuwa saw ku luma’ nu misu
lines.displayText: Icuwa saw ku luma’ nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: I Natauran ku luma’ nu maku.

quests.quest: 上課了，老師請你們寫筆記。你忘記帶筆了，同學好像有多的筆。
quests.tips: 快想想辦法，問「（同學名字），借我筆好嗎？」，請同學借你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw pacaliw haw kaku tu sapisurit
lines.displayText: Kacaw! Pacaliw haw kaku tu sapisurit?

reply.indigenousText: Hay, pacaliway nu maku kisu.

lines.indigenousText: Panay pacaliw haw kaku tu sapisurit
lines.displayText: Panay, pacaliw haw kaku tu sapisurit?

reply.indigenousText: Cacay ku nu maku.

quests.quest: 你不小心寫錯字了，需要橡皮擦，但發現忘了帶。
quests.tips: 快想想辦法，問「（同學名字），借我橡皮擦好嗎？」，請同學借你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw pacaliwi kaku tu savuric kapah tu haw
lines.displayText: Kacaw! pacaliwi kaku tu savuric kapah tu haw?

reply.indigenousText: Caay ka sisavuric kaku.

lines.indigenousText: Panay pacaliwi kaku tu savuric kapah tu haw
lines.displayText: Panay! pacaliwi kaku tu savuric kapah tu haw?

reply.indigenousText: Hayi, alai

quests.quest: 老師分配你掃地工作，掃把在你同學旁邊．
quests.tips: 跟同學說「（同學名字），請幫我拿掃把。」，請同學拿給你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw padangi kaku a miala tu saasik
lines.displayText: Kacaw! Padangi kaku a miala tu saasik.

reply.indigenousText: Ya, nu misu kinian a saasik.

lines.indigenousText: Panay padangi kaku a miala tu saasik
lines.displayText: Panay, padangi kaku a miala tu saasik

reply.indigenousText: Caay kavana’ kaku i cuwa ku saasik.

themes.name: 尋找物品
themes.intro: 今天家裡要辦婚禮，很多親戚都來了。看到大家忙得不可開交，主角決定要幫大家一起準備。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Ina, aluman ku tayniyay a lalumaan anini!
turns.chineseText: 媽媽今天家裡來了好多親戚哦！

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: U karamudan ni kaka anini a remiad, sisa aluman ku tayniyay nu tamdaw.
turns.chineseText: 今天是哥哥的婚禮，所以有很多人來。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Malipahak kaku! matunes tu a caay kasasuaraw i tu heniyan!
turns.chineseText: 好開心喔！很久沒有看到他們了！

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Hayi, awaay ku lawad nu alumanay i anini a remiad, pipadangi kisu tu alumanay.
turns.chineseText: 對啊！今天大家都會很忙，你要幫忙大家。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Hay, padangay tu nu maku.

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: A malekakawa kaku tu sakadademak anu sasawni.
turns.chineseText: 我要去準備等一下要用的東西了。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Akuay ku mipadangay.

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Hay, duduen kaku.

quests.quest: 媽媽把陶壺搞混了，請你幫忙找出新訂做的陶壺。
quests.tips: 去問問看「新的陶壺長怎樣？」，找出陶壺吧！

lines.indigenousText: mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu
lines.displayText: Mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu?

reply.indigenousText: U kidudung ku satavu nu maku.

lines.indigenousText: mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu
lines.displayText: Mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu?

reply.indigenousText: U lahengangay a kidudung ku satavu ni ina.

lines.indigenousText: mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu
lines.displayText: Mamaanay saw a vacuan kira valuhayay a atumu?

reply.indigenousText: Mapawan kaku.

quests.quest: 阿嬤在包cinavu，發現月桃葉不夠了，請你去採。
quests.tips: 趕快去問問看「哪裡有月桃？」，採一些放到籃子裡吧！

lines.indigenousText: icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac
lines.displayText: Icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac?

reply.indigenousText: A mavana’ haw kaku!

lines.indigenousText: icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac
lines.displayText: Icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac?

reply.indigenousText: Ira tu i lutuk.

lines.indigenousText: icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac
lines.displayText: Icuwa saw ku langaw nu lalengac?

reply.indigenousText: Siusaw ku nu maku. ya! nu misu kinian.

quests.quest: 爸爸在點聘禮的數量，發現檳榔數量不對。
quests.tips: 趕快問問看其他人「你有看到檳榔嗎？」，找出檳榔，把它們放在一起吧！

lines.indigenousText: namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep
lines.displayText: Namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay i takuwan.

lines.indigenousText: namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep
lines.displayText: Namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep?

reply.indigenousText: Ira i kudul nu elun.

lines.indigenousText: namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep
lines.displayText: Namakamelaw haw kisu tu icep?

reply.indigenousText: Itira i lalavu nu kanas.

quests.quest: 婚禮快要開始了，親友們都在門外準備。
quests.tips: 咦，哥哥怎麼不見了？快點問問看「哥哥在哪裡？」，把哥哥找出來吧！

lines.indigenousText: i cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan
lines.displayText: I cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay a mamelaw, talacuwaay tu hakiya?

lines.indigenousText: i cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan
lines.displayText: I cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan?

reply.indigenousText: Caay henay haw katahekal cira?

lines.indigenousText: i cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan
lines.displayText: I cuwa saw ci kaka tu vavainayan?

reply.indigenousText: A waay haw a mamelaw? kilimen cira, sakalemkamen!

quests.quest: 忙了一輪，終於一切就緒。婚禮要開始了，快點出發吧！

goal.endText: 忙了一輪，終於一切就緒。婚禮要開始了，快點出發吧！

themes.name: 戶外活動
themes.intro: 今天是星期六。主角正在和哥哥聊天，討論明天的行程。來看看他們要去哪裡玩吧！

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Payuaw! U pilipayan anucila, a talacuwa saw kisu?
turns.chineseText: Payu，明天是星期天，你打算去哪裡？

turns.speaker: sibling
turns.indigenousText: Anucila a tala lilis nu sauwac a mi’id’id tu titi kaku aci Lisin, kisu i?
turns.chineseText: 我明天要和Lisin去溪邊烤肉，你呢？

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Ngaay namu! anu mihakulung kaku kapah tu hakiya?
turns.chineseText: 聽起來很好玩！我也可以一起去嗎？

turns.speaker: sibling
turns.indigenousText: Pipalitai hen ci inaan isu!

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Inaaw, kapah tu haw kaku a mihakulung ci kakaan a tala i sauwac?
turns.chineseText: 媽媽，我可以跟哥哥一起去溪邊嗎？

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Kapah tu! piarawi tu kamu!

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Hayi, mavana’ tu kami.

quests.quest: 公車快要來了，但你們還沒買食材和工具。
quests.tips: 問問看其他人「你要找什麼？」，檢視購物清單，找出還沒買到的東西，點選物品把它們放進購物籃吧！

lines.indigenousText: u maan saw ku kiliman nu misu
lines.displayText: U maan saw ku kiliman nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: Mikilim kaku tu avel atu sapi’id’id tu titi a tatadaan.

lines.indigenousText: u maan saw ku kiliman nu misu
lines.displayText: U maan saw ku kiliman nu misu?

reply.indigenousText: Mikilim kaku tu taviras atu vunga.

quests.quest: 你們提早了一站下車，不知道該往哪走。
quests.tips: 哥哥請你幫忙詢問路人「溪邊要往哪裡走？」。趕快找出往溪邊的路吧！

lines.indigenousText: a pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac
lines.displayText: A pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac?

reply.indigenousText: Itila i tepar niya tataakay a vekeluh.

lines.indigenousText: a pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac
lines.displayText: A pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac?

reply.indigenousText: Caay kavana’ kaku icuwaan a lilis nu sa’uwac.

lines.indigenousText: a pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac
lines.displayText: A pasacuwa saw ku sakatayra i sa’uwac?

reply.indigenousText: Itini, Namakayra kaku i lilis nu sa’uwac i nasani.

quests.quest: 你正準備切菜，卻發現沒有刀子。
quests.tips: 去問看看其他人「可以借我刀子嗎？」，別忘了和對方說「謝謝你的幫忙！」喔！

goal.prompt: aray han nu maku tu nipipadang nu misu

closing.text: aray han nu maku tu nipipadang nu misu

lines.indigenousText: pacaliwi kaku tu puut kapah tu haw
lines.displayText: Pacaliwi kaku tu puut, kapah tu haw?

reply.indigenousText: kapah tu! ala i!

lines.indigenousText: pacaliwi kaku tu puut kapah tu haw
lines.displayText: Pacaliwi kaku tu puut, kapah tu haw?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay ku nu maku.

lines.indigenousText: pacaliwi kaku tu puut kapah tu haw
lines.displayText: Pacaliwi kaku tu puut, kapah tu haw?

reply.indigenousText: Aka, mapeci’ ku puut nu maku.

quests.quest: 太陽下山了！你們今天都玩得很開心，還約好下次要再一起去溪邊玩。趕快回家吧！

goal.endText: 太陽下山了！你們今天都玩得很開心，還約好下次要再一起去溪邊玩。趕快回家吧！
